strengths: Verified-identifier density: valid Dataverse DOI used consistently across id/doi/page/citation, valid NIH grant numbers with RePORTER-level detail (award amount, period, supplement), valid Cellosaurus RRIDs for both cell lines, and ORCIDs for all 16 creators
Internally consistent quantitative claims: total_file_count and total_size_bytes match the sums of the 10 per-archive entries, and every distributed archive carries an MD5 checksum

recommendations: Add a 'variables' section describing the column structure of the tabular derived products, starting with the CRISPRi Perturbation Cell Atlas and the AP-MS/SEC-MS interaction tables
Reconcile the MDA-MB-468 perturb-seq claim: state explicitly whether those data are inside a distributed archive, external-only, or embargoed, and align description, subsets, and file_collections
Add an anomalies entry covering known QC outcomes, outliers, or batch effects for the released archives (or an explicit statement that none are documented by the sources)
Record cell-line donor consent provenance (ATCC terms, HipSci consent framework) under raw_data_sources.access_details if available in source documentation
State whether conflicts of interest were assessed in ethical_reviews, and add per-file Dataverse Data Access API URLs to distribution_formats
